origins.origins_classes_iss.bard.name: Bard
origins.origins_classes_iss.mystic.descr: Holy caster and bane of undead.
origins.origins_classes_iss.mystic.name: Mystic

origins.origins_classes_iss.warlock.desc: A caster with a pact with a stronger magical being.
origins.origins_classes_iss.warlock.name: Warlock
origins.origins_classes_iss.warmage.desc: A mage highly focused on combat.

power.origins_classes_iss.archmagus_armo: The Archmagus begins with a full set of Wandering Magician Armor
power.origins_classes_iss.archmagus_heal: You have 2 less hearts of health than normal.
power.origins_classes_iss.archmagus_weak: Deals 75% less damage with melee attacks.
power.origins_classes_iss.bard_hide_from: While sneaking, you can hide from skeletons that haven't seen you yet.
power.origins_classes_iss.bard_inspirati: When you play a goat horn, all nearby players and wolves gain Strenth I for 5 minutes
power.origins_classes_iss.bard_melodic_p: Bards have 20% more Melody Spell Power. (Requires Tunes n Tomes)
power.origins_classes_iss.bard_rattle_bo: Chase away spiders and silverfish while holding bones.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_holy_sp: Mystics have 20% greater Holy Spell Power.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_illager: Mystics take 25% greater damage from Illagers.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_resista: Villagers you trade with gain Resistance IV permanently.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_scroll_: Gain 1 minute of Health Boost after using a scroll.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_turn_un: When equipped with a Nether Star, all undead fear you.
power.origins_classes_iss.shadowcaster_d: Shadowcasters cast spells 10% better in the dark.
Gain 20% Spell Resistance in the darkness.
You have 5% less spell power during the day.
You gain Night Vision in the darkness.
power.origins_classes_iss.shadowcaster_e: You have 20% better Ender Spell Power
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_fire_: You have 10% better Fire Spell Power.
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_healt: You have 1 less heart of health than normal.
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_ice_p: You have 10% better Ice Spell Power.
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_oaksk: Gain Oakskin when under half health.
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_spell: Sorcerers have a 25% chance of gaining weakness when melee attacking.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_eldrit: You have 20% greater Eldritch Spell Power.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_golden: You must eat a Golden Apple everyday as sacrifice to your Patron or suffer weakness.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_magic_: You can cast Magic Missile at night naturally.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_penalt: If you haven't made sacrifice to your patron, gain Slowness II and Weakness II.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_retrib: Any Entity that damages you gains 30 seconds of weakness.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_starte: Warlocks begin with a Golden Apple.
power.origins_classes_iss.warmage_scroll: Gain 30 seconds of Charge after using a scroll.
power.origins_classes_iss.warmage_spell_: Gain +10% Spell Power when under half health.
You have 10% less spell resistance when over half health.
power.origins_classes_iss.wizard_essence: You can make arcane essence from four Lapis Lazuli.
power.origins_classes_iss.wizard_ink_rec: You can craft your own common ink from Arcane Essence, an Ink Sac and a Glass Bottle.
power.origins_classes_iss.wizard_spellbo: You begin with a spellbook and the Firecracker spell.
